If you have any questions, please don't hesitate to contact [[:Category:Administrators|one of us]] for more information! -- [[User:Mainphramephreak|Mainphramephreak]] ([[User_talk:Mainphramephreak|Talk]]) 05:09, December 19, 2011

== Welcome ==

Hello. Thanks for joining us and creating those pages. A few things, though. Please take a moment to read over [[Help:Style guide|the style guide page]] to become familiar with the way pages should be layed out. Also, if you are going to be creating pages, please make sure to remove the placeholder image that shows up. If you have any other questions, please let me know. Thanks again and welcome! ---- {{User:Mainphramephreak/Sig/Subst}} 06:44, December 19, 2011 (UTC)

No worries! We learn by doing. Take a look at some of he differences to see what I've changed on the pages to see how the pages are formatted. As always, let me know if you have questions. ---- {{User:Mainphramephreak/Sig/Subst}} 07:12, December 19, 2011 (UTC)

If you're still around, join me in the chat room if you'd like. Thanks! ---- {{User:Mainphramephreak/Sig/Subst}} 07:32, December 19, 2011 (UTC)

== Edits ==

Hello. Thanks for adding all of those new pages! Always great to see our page count go up. In the future, though, could you make sure to use the "Preview" button. A lot of the small fixes that I did were just general capitalization and punctuation. I've also put together some instructions on using the {{tl|Character}} template that should help in making new character pages. Again, thanks for adding those pages. Let me know if you have any questions. ---- {{User:Mainphramephreak/Sig/Subst}} 00:07, April 2, 2012 (UTC)
